verdict: Paid campaigns are paused; organic is holding while contract is resolved.
narrative: No paid spend ran across Meta or Google in the last 28 days, which means zero paid leads for the period. Organic activity continued to carry the load — your Google Business Profile generated 136 actions including 49 direct calls, and your website received 1,624 sessions from search and other organic sources. A reporting gap in the GBP data for the first week of September is being investigated and does not reflect a true loss of local visibility. Paid campaigns cannot restart until the engagement agreement is signed; once that is in place, ads are ready to go live and intake automation will be brought fully online alongside them.

highlights.phrase: direct calls from your Google Business Profile in the last 28 days
website sessions driven by organic search this period
paid ad spend this period — campaigns are currently paused

watch_item.issue: The engagement extension is unsigned, which is blocking paid campaign restart and intake automation setup.
watch_item.fix: Once the agreement is signed, paid ads and SMS/voice intake tools go live immediately — both are staged and ready.
